presetNotes: One must imagine obsidian being range masterwork. Use melee for general DPS, range when needing more surviability. Since arch glacor is poisonable and is a rather long fight we will have ample time to build up bik arrow stacks, this combined with cinderbane and things like armour spikes and recoil allows for a lot of damage coming from poison, poison which is also boosted by equilibrium. Remember to prepot overload, kwuarm and lantadyme inceanse sticks, and powder of penance and protection. If doing more advanced tech also build a few leng stacks on a dummy in pvm hub. also on said dummy prepot a dragon battle axe spec then get back to full adren. Remember to store a master magic cape on the skillcape rack for double the time of vulnerability, smoke bomb, and most importantly enfeeble with IotH will have 100% uptime
